title: Facade grid: recessed windows, panel seams, no repeated module runs
note: Recessed windows, panel seams and facade variants break a slab; flat repeated boxes score generic every time.
intent: Flat repeated boxes with painted-on windows score "generic" every time, and in a doomer dvor the panel seams of the khrushchyovka facade are the scene’s identity feature — a run that ended with beautiful branch snow and generic facades lost. Per facade: window openings recessed with a darker glazing plane inset ≥ 0.1 m (5 cm is the floor, 10 cm is what scored), horizontal and vertical panel seam lines so no large plane is a "flat blank slab", a darker plinth band at the base (0.5–1.0 m, mossy and wet-dark at a waterline), and ≥ 3 distinct facade variants — no two adjacent buildings share width, height and roof pitch, and every ≥ 4-unit run of identical modules is broken by an interruption (buttress, gap, differing course height). Any large background plane must carry course lines, a value gradient toward the fog, or a broken top edge.

check.js: objects('window').length >= 2 && objects('window').every(w => (w.userData.recess || 0) >= 0.1) && count('seam') >= 4 && (objects('facade').length < 3 || new Set(objects('facade').map(f => f.userData.variant)).size >= 3)
check.note: Windows recessed >= 0.1 m (userData.recess), >= 4 panel seam lines break the slab, >= 3 facade variants once 3+ facades exist; flat repeated boxes score generic every time.

port: Use makePanelFacade() in the buildings module (src/city.js), expose userData.recess on every window group and userData.variant on every facade, tag seams "seam"; rank facades first in the facet’s priority order and do not polish props while this check still fails.

evidence.note: identity features outrank micro-detail: the khrushchyovka panel seams in a doomer dvor come before props; "flat blank slab" needs course lines, a value gradient or a broken top edge; break every ≥4-unit run of identical modules
per facade: recessed window openings with a darker glazing plane inset ≥5 cm, stone plinth at the waterline, no two adjacent houses identical
recessed glazing ≥0.1 m depth, plinth 0.5–1.0 m with a moss band, ≥3 distinct facade variants so rows do not repeat
break flat slabs with ≥3 depth layers (recessed openings, offset plinth, overhanging roof edge); guard Shape/Extrude coordinates with isFinite
Iterations spent on micro-detail while panel facades stayed broken and became the final gap; name openings and recess depth in cm, not a style word
